{
  "back": {
    "de-00": {"english": "PAUSE", "notes": ""},
    "de-01": {"english": "MRDEMONWOLF, INC. PRESENTS", "notes": ""},
    "de-02": {"english": "CHAPTER 1  /  SEALING OFF", "notes": ""},
    "de-03": {"english": "NEW GAME", "notes": ""},
    "de-04": {"english": "CONTINUE", "notes": ""},
    "de-05": {"english": "CONTRIBUTORS", "notes": ""},
    "de-06": {"english": "SETTINGS", "notes": ""},
    "de-07": {"english": "CHANGES", "notes": ""},
    "de-08": {"english": "Concept: Nathanial Henniges  /  AI-assisted development", "notes": ""},
    "de-09": {"english": "LANGUAGE", "notes": ""},
    "de-10": {"english": "The pressure relief valve discharged beneath %s. If the indicator is at its limit, get off the grate.", "notes": "'Unter %s' can mean beneath %s or under a condition represented by %s. 'Ausgeblasen' describes blowing or discharging, without specifying what was discharged."},
    "de-11": {"english": "PLAY AGAIN", "notes": ""},
    "de-12": {"english": "No checkpoint yet. Saving begins at the first SAVE POINT.", "notes": "'Sicherungspunkt' can also mean a securing or safety point."},
    "de-13": {"english": "The Director believes WOLF is still in standby.", "notes": "'Der Direktor' is masculine."},
    "de-14": {"english": "Nobody gives an activation command.\nWOLF wakes himself up.", "notes": ""},
    "de-15": {"english": "The guard saw %s outdoors.\nStay close to the TANK TRIGGER.", "notes": "'Der Wächter' is masculine. 'Im Freien' specifically means outdoors. 'Tankauslöser' does not specify what action the trigger causes."},
    "de-16": {"english": "%s  MOVE", "notes": ""},
    "de-17": {"english": "%s  READ DISPLAY (optional)", "notes": "'Anzeige' can mean a display, indicator or readout."},
    "de-18": {"english": "Go right to the circuit breaker.", "notes": ""},
    "de-19": {"english": "Or go right to the circuit breaker.", "notes": ""},
    "de-20": {"english": "03:17 / CONTAINMENT", "notes": ""},
    "de-21": {"english": "%s  CONTINUE    %s  PAUSE", "notes": ""},
    "de-22": {"english": "%s  CONTINUE", "notes": ""},
    "de-23": {"english": "PAUSE: Skip intro", "notes": ""},
    "de-24": {"english": "MAINTENANCE TECHNOLOGY", "notes": "Names a technical field or function, not an individual technician."},
    "de-25": {"english": "SUPPLY NODE", "notes": "'Versorgung' can refer to power, utilities or other supplies."},
    "de-26": {"english": "MAINTENANCE / SEALING OFF", "notes": ""},
    "de-27": {"english": "%s  REPEAT", "notes": "Can mean repeat or retry, depending on what is being repeated."},
    "de-28": {"english": "E: Read the Director's purge display.", "notes": "'Säuberung' can mean cleaning, cleansing or a purge. 'Direktor' is masculine."},
    "de-29": {"english": "HOLD E: crank the manual bypass, %d of %d.", "notes": "'HALTEN E' has unnatural German word order for a hold-key instruction."},
    "de-30": {"english": "E: Talk with WOLF about the relay.", "notes": "'Über das Relais' can mean about the relay or via the relay."},
    "de-31": {"english": "Find the circuit breaker. WOLF follows you.", "notes": ""},
    "de-32": {"english": "SWITCH ON CIRCUIT BREAKER", "notes": ""},
    "de-33": {"english": "CHECK CIRCUIT BREAKER", "notes": ""},
    "es-00": {"english": "PAUSE", "notes": ""},
    "es-01": {"english": "MRDEMONWOLF, INC. PRESENTS", "notes": ""},
    "es-02": {"english": "CHAPTER 1  /  BLOCKAGE", "notes": "'Bloqueo' can mean blockage, blockade, blocking or lockdown."},
    "es-03": {"english": "NEW GAME", "notes": ""},
    "es-04": {"english": "CONTINUE", "notes": ""},
    "es-05": {"english": "CREDITS", "notes": ""},
    "es-06": {"english": "SETTINGS", "notes": ""},
    "es-07": {"english": "CHANGES", "notes": ""},
    "es-08": {"english": "Concept: Nathanial Henniges  /  AI-assisted development", "notes": ""},
    "es-09": {"english": "LANGUAGE", "notes": ""},
    "es-10": {"english": "The relief valve burst beneath %s. When the pressure gauge reaches the maximum, do not step on the grate.", "notes": "'Estalló' means burst or exploded."},
    "es-11": {"english": "PLAY AGAIN", "notes": ""},
    "es-12": {"english": "There is no checkpoint yet. Saving begins at the first SAFE POINT.", "notes": ""},
    "es-13": {"english": "The Director believes WOLF is still waiting.", "notes": "'En espera' can mean waiting, on hold or on standby. 'El Director' is masculine."},
    "es-14": {"english": "Nobody gives an activation order.\nWOLF wakes up by himself.", "notes": "'Solo' is masculine and can mean alone or without assistance."},
    "es-15": {"english": "The sentry saw %s out in the open.\nStay close to RELEASE TANK.", "notes": "'El centinela' is grammatically masculine. 'SOLTAR TANQUE' is an action label used awkwardly as a location; 'soltar' can mean release, let go of or drop."},
    "es-16": {"english": "%s  MOVE", "notes": ""},
    "es-17": {"english": "%s  READ SCREEN (optional)", "notes": ""},
    "es-18": {"english": "Go right, to the switch.", "notes": "'Interruptor' means switch and does not specifically identify a circuit breaker."},
    "es-19": {"english": "Or go right, to the switch.", "notes": "'Interruptor' means switch and does not specifically identify a circuit breaker."},
    "es-20": {"english": "03:17 / CONTAINMENT", "notes": ""},
    "es-21": {"english": "%s  CONTINUE    %s  PAUSE", "notes": ""},
    "es-22": {"english": "%s  CONTINUE", "notes": ""},
    "es-23": {"english": "PAUSE: skip the introduction", "notes": ""},
    "es-24": {"english": "MAINTENANCE ENGINEERING", "notes": "Names a discipline or department, not an individual engineer."},
    "es-25": {"english": "SERVICE JUNCTION", "notes": "'Empalme' can mean a splice, joint or connection."},
    "es-26": {"english": "MAINTENANCE / BLOCKAGE", "notes": "'Bloqueo' can mean blockage, blockade, blocking or lockdown."},
    "es-27": {"english": "%s  RETRY", "notes": ""},
    "es-28": {"english": "E: read the Director's purge screen.", "notes": "'Director' is masculine."},
    "es-29": {"english": "HOLD E: turn the manual bypass, %d of %d.", "notes": "'Girar' means turn or rotate; it does not specifically say to crank."},
    "es-30": {"english": "E: talk with WOLF about the relay.", "notes": "'Sobre el relé' means about the relay, not through it."},
    "es-31": {"english": "Find the switch. WOLF will follow your footsteps.", "notes": "'Interruptor' does not specifically identify a circuit breaker. 'Seguirá tus pasos' can also mean follow your example."},
    "es-32": {"english": "ACTIVATE THE SWITCH", "notes": "'Interruptor' does not specifically identify a circuit breaker."},
    "es-33": {"english": "CHECK THE SWITCH", "notes": "'Interruptor' does not specifically identify a circuit breaker."},
    "ja-00": {"english": "PAUSE", "notes": ""},
    "ja-01": {"english": "MRDEMONWOLF, INC. PRESENTATION", "notes": "'提供' can indicate presentation, provision or sponsorship."},
    "ja-02": {"english": "CHAPTER 1  /  LOCKDOWN", "notes": ""},
    "ja-03": {"english": "NEW GAME", "notes": ""},
    "ja-04": {"english": "CONTINUE", "notes": ""},
    "ja-05": {"english": "CREDITS", "notes": ""},
    "ja-06": {"english": "SETTINGS", "notes": ""},
    "ja-07": {"english": "UPDATE HISTORY", "notes": ""},
    "ja-08": {"english": "Original concept: Nathanial Henniges  /  Development with AI assistance", "notes": ""},
    "ja-09": {"english": "LANGUAGE", "notes": ""},
    "ja-10": {"english": "The relief vent erupted at %s's feet. If the gauge goes off the scale, move away from the grating.", "notes": "The wording makes the vent itself the subject of 'erupted'; it leaves the discharged substance unstated."},
    "ja-11": {"english": "PLAY ONCE MORE", "notes": ""},
    "ja-12": {"english": "There is no checkpoint yet. Saving begins at the first safe point.", "notes": ""},
    "ja-13": {"english": "The head of the facility thinks WOLF is still in standby mode.", "notes": "'所長' means the head of a facility or institution; it is not gendered."},
    "ja-14": {"english": "Nobody has issued a startup command.\nWOLF wakes up of his own accord.", "notes": "The source does not specify gender."},
    "ja-15": {"english": "The sentry found %s in an open area.\nStay near the tank drop.", "notes": "'タンク投下' names dropping a tank, not explicitly a control or location. 'Tank' could refer to a container or an armored vehicle."},
    "ja-16": {"english": "%s  MOVE", "notes": ""},
    "ja-17": {"english": "%s  READ DISPLAY (optional)", "notes": ""},
    "ja-18": {"english": "Head to the breaker on the right.", "notes": ""},
    "ja-19": {"english": "Or to the breaker on the right.", "notes": "The movement verb is omitted."},
    "ja-20": {"english": "03:17 / CONTAINMENT SECTION", "notes": "'収容区画' means a section for housing, holding or containing something, rather than containment as an action."},
    "ja-21": {"english": "%s  CONTINUE    %s  PAUSE", "notes": ""},
    "ja-22": {"english": "%s  CONTINUE", "notes": ""},
    "ja-23": {"english": "PAUSE: SKIP THE OPENING", "notes": ""},
    "ja-24": {"english": "MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN", "notes": "The role is not gendered."},
    "ja-25": {"english": "SERVICE JUNCTION", "notes": "Uses transliterated English terms; the type of service or junction is unspecified."},
    "ja-26": {"english": "MAINTENANCE SECTION / LOCKDOWN", "notes": ""},
    "ja-27": {"english": "%s  RETRY", "notes": ""},
    "ja-28": {"english": "E: Read the facility head's purge display", "notes": "'所長' means the head of a facility or institution; it is not gendered."},
    "ja-29": {"english": "HOLD E: Turn the manual bypass (%d / %d)", "notes": "'回す' means turn or rotate; it does not specifically say to crank."},
    "ja-30": {"english": "E: Talk with WOLF about the relay", "notes": "'について' explicitly means about, not via."},
    "ja-31": {"english": "Let's look for the breaker. WOLF follows along behind.", "notes": "Whom WOLF follows is omitted."},
    "ja-32": {"english": "TURN ON THE BREAKER", "notes": ""},
    "ja-33": {"english": "CHECK THE BREAKER", "notes": ""}
  }
}
